name: The Hills Have Eyes

angles.text: Aamelia grimly jokes about stitching a blanket from blood-stained bandit masks for Ferauu.

aliases: what is the hills have eyes
faq.answer: Aamelia asks travelers to strike a bandit camp in the northern hills before Ferauu’s highwaymen attack her farm. She also asks for blood-stained masks from the fallen bandits.
faq.q: What is The Hills Have Eyes?

aliases: who gives the hills have eyes
faq.answer: Aamelia gives the request from her farm in the Gustberry Lowlands. Weeks of waiting for the bandits have left her dreading their attack.
faq.q: Who gives the quest The Hills Have Eyes?

faq.answer: Ferauu leads the highwayman bandits around the Gustberry Lowlands. His gang threatens Aamelia’s farm and is preparing to attack.
Highwayman Bandits have camps throughout the Gustberry Lowlands, including a small camp in the hills directly north of Aamelia’s farm.
faq.q: Where are the highwayman bandits located?

faq.answer: Aamelia asks for blood-stained masks as proof of the ambush. The strike on the bandits’ camp helps even the odds before Ferauu’s attack.
faq.q: Why does Aamelia want blood-stained bandit masks?

aliases: what happens after the hills have eyes
faq.answer: After the hill camp is struck, Aamelia finds hope for her farm. Ferauu and his remaining bandits are due to arrive at any moment, and she must face their attack.
faq.q: What happens after completing the quest?

sections.body: Aamelia faces an approaching attack in the Gustberry Lowlands. Ferauu leads the outlaws threatening her farm. She asks you to strike their camp in the hills to the north. Thin the highwaymen’s ranks before they gather, and Aamelia hopes to weaken their attack and gain time before they arrive.
sections.title: A Preemptive Strike

sections.body:
Aamelia asks you to bring back blood-stained masks from the fallen highwaymen as proof of the ambush. Grimly, she jokes about stitching them into a blanket for Ferauu. She is glad her tormentors met fierce resistance.

The strike on the northern camp ends weeks of hopeless waiting. Aamelia has new courage to face Ferauu and his main band when they arrive.
sections.title: Renewed Hope and Retribution

summary: Aamelia faces a bandit assault in the Gustberry Lowlands, and Ferauu’s raid draws near. She sends travelers to strike a camp in the northern hills before the bandits gather.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Hills Have Eyes
